scope: Seven completed plain NaFlex G2 runs. Saved run artifacts and frozen attempts only.

validation.source_scope: No live catalogue, images, services or indexes read. The saved done state records the runner completion-time identity check; the offline check validates persisted evidence.

notes: All seven use the same actual NaFlex model with different request patch budgets and configured indexes.
Crop-versus-as-is pairs use the same index. The crop-seg pair adds remove_background to the ordinary p256 crop.

p1024 uses a newly completed index with 4181 current vectors and 2096 full / 2092 label wines. p256/p512 each have 4054 current items and 2051 full / 2047 label wines. The p1024 comparison also changes catalogue coverage.
All profiles retrieve the full view only. Label-view index coverage is reported for completeness.
Every query stays in its fixed denominator. There are zero errors and zero degraded queries; none were omitted.
A forbidden negative prediction violates the row constraint. An allowed negative prediction is not a verified identification.
use_barcode=true in queue requests does not create a barcode stage. The configured profiles have no barcode step, and no trace contains one.
All run with use_cache=true and four workers. SAM3 flags are observed; embedding cache hits are not recorded.
Run walls measure cached bulk execution. They do not measure fresh sequential HTTP recognition or prove a three-second demo deadline.
The 60 package steps with cached=null use the alpha-image path and do not call SAM3.
The http200 count reflects saved bulk result http_status fields. It does not establish an HTTP recognition measurement.
